title: Delayed Optimizer-State Transport Shapes Short-Horizon Training Decisions
abstract: arXiv:2608.24593v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adaptive optimizers retain gradient history in moment variables, allowing a local change in loss weighting to alter later updates. We examine whether this delayed transport is large enough to change prospective short-horizon decisions. On committed future-minibatch sequences, we differentiate eight-step AdamW trajectories through the complete model--optimizer state and select exposure-matched Math--Code loss schedules before independent evaluation. Across 12 unused 0.3M Transformer histories, full transport lowers token-disjoint loss relative to an optimizer-aware immediate derivative in 10/12 histories (mean benefit $4.71\times10^{-4}$; exact one-sided sign test, $p=0.0193$). The two controllers act equally often but select different schedules in 60/96 windows. translated_title: 延迟的优化器状态传输影响短时程训练决策
translated_abstract: 自适应优化器在动量变量中保留梯度历史，使得损失加权的局部变化能够改变后续更新。我们研究了这种延迟传输是否足够大以改变预期的短时程决策。在已确定的未来小批量序列上，我们通过完整的模型-优化器状态对八步AdamW轨迹进行微分，并在独立评估前选择暴露匹配的数学-代码损失调度。在12个未使用的0.3M Transformer历史中，相对于优化器感知的即时导数，完整传输在10/12个历史中降低了令牌不重叠损失（平均收益$4.71\times10^{-4}$；精确单侧符号检验，$p=0.0193$）。两个控制器同样频繁地作用，但在60/96个窗口中选择了不同的调度。交叉检查点-未来路径测试将此重排序归因于优化器状态与近未来数据之间的交互，而独立的Ising-CNN实验显示了类似效果。
tldr: 本文发现优化器状态中的延迟传输能显著影响短时程训练决策，在多数情况下优于即时导数方法，并通过实验验证了其重要性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that delayed optimizer-state transport significantly influences short-horizon training decisions, outperforming immediate-derivative methods in most cases, and validates its importance through experiments.
